title: 第13章 当庭宣判第14章 你当尼玛律师
slug: 律师霸凌者无罪我送他死刑
content_zh:
“我看了这么多年的校园霸凌，总是在说保护未成年，保护未成年，我听够了！我今天还就判了！”
王正华敲著桌子怒道。
“王院....”陈广泰嚇的都不敢说话了。
这傢伙这么突然这么猛了。
王正华开始打电话给最高法院，让他意外的是，那边也是火速通过了。
“王正华，办的漂亮点，我们的法律应该是来保护孩子们茁壮成长的，这也是民意，既然已经有了证据，就不要有压力。”
“是！”
王正华心里一喜，掛断了电话。
“陈院长，组织合议庭吧，我们有核准权了。”
“呃..好。”
很快，江海高院的资深法官们都行动了起来，纷纷放下手中的工作赶来了会议室。
一群人开始拿著林默提交的证据开始研究。
其中涉及入室抢劫罪，故意伤害罪，侮辱罪誹谤罪等等。
法庭上。
大家都很寂静，没有人觉得等待是一件漫长的事情。
太郑重了，所有人都期待著结果。
“林律师，他们真的会死刑吗？”王乐乐小声的问道。
“放心，包的。”
林默露出微笑，身为金牌律师就是如此的自信。
同一时间，罗大翔直播间。

“罗老师，您能猜测一下判罚吗？”
罗大翔：“目前证据充足，具体怎么判，那就看法院了，但无论怎么说，这一场都是林默贏了，而且贏的非常漂亮！”
“毕竟无论是入室抢劫罪，还是校园霸凌，反正霸凌者都受到了法律的制裁。”
罗大翔知道，这一场庭审过后，网络上绝对会掀起舆论风暴！
时间过得很快。一晃眼过去了一个小时。
王正华以及两个审判员都走了出来。
王正华依旧满脸严肃，眼神凌厉，步伐矫健。
此刻，庭审现场寂静无声，那种紧张的氛围已经拉满了。
审判台上，王正华拿起了法槌：
“现在开庭，请控告方和被告方做最后的陈述。”
“控告方，你方做好最后的陈诉准备了吗？”
“嗯，我方已经做好准备。”
“那么，开始吧。”
林默整理了一下衣服，郑重的站了起来：“审判长，我想先请问被告方田英光一个问题。”
咚！
“是否和本案有关係？”
content_en:
"I have watched school bullying for so many years. They always talk about protecting minors and protecting minors. I have heard enough! I will sentence you today!"
Wang Zhenghua knocked on the table and said angrily.
"Wang Yuan..." Chen Guangtai was so frightened that he didn't dare to speak.
This guy is so fierce all of a sudden.
Wang Zhenghua started calling the Supreme Court. To his surprise, the case was passed quickly.
"Wang Zhenghua, make it more beautiful. Our laws should be to protect children from growing up. This is also public opinion. Now that there is evidence, there is no pressure."
"Yes!"
Wang Zhenghua felt happy and hung up the phone.
"Dean Chen, please organize a collegial panel. We have the authority to approve it."
"Uh..Okay."
Soon, the senior judges of Jianghai High Court took action and put down their work and rushed to the conference room.
A group of people began to study the evidence submitted by Lin Mo.
These include burglary, intentional injury, insult, defamation, etc.
in court.
Everyone was quiet, and no one felt that waiting was a long time.
It was so solemn and everyone was looking forward to the result.
"Lawyer Lin, will they really impose the death penalty?" Wang Lele asked in a low voice.
"Don't worry, it's covered."
Lin Mo smiled. As a gold medal lawyer, he was so confident.
At the same time, Luo Daxiang’s live broadcast room.
"Teacher Luo, can you guess the penalty?"
Luo Daxiang: "There is sufficient evidence at present. It depends on the court how to decide the specific verdict. But no matter what, Lin Mo won this game, and he won very beautifully!"
"After all, whether it's home invasion or school bullying, bullies are punished by the law anyway."
Luo Daxiang knows that after this court trial, there will definitely be a storm of public opinion on the Internet!
Time flies. An hour passed in the blink of an eye.
Wang Zhenghua and the two judges all walked out.
Wang Zhenghua still had a serious face, sharp eyes and vigorous steps.
At this moment, the court hearing was silent, and the tense atmosphere was already full.
On the trial stage, Wang Zhenghua picked up the gavel:
"The court is now open, please let the prosecution and the defense make their final statements."
"Prosecutor, are you ready for your final statement?"
"Well, we are ready."
"Then, let's get started."
Lin Mo straightened his clothes and stood up solemnly: "Presiding Judge, I would like to ask the defendant Fang Tian Yingguang a question first."
Boom!
"Is it related to this case?"
